desc:
SAN FRANCISCO IS YOUR PLAYGROUND.

From the iconic Golden Gate Bridge to the streets of San Francisco, every corner of the city is yours to discover.

🎟️ CODES : NEWREALEASE

SF BIKE brings the California riding experience to Roblox. Take on the city with powerful motorcycles, electric scooters, BMX bikes, and more — each ride brings a different way to experience the streets.

WHAT'S WAITING FOR YOU?
🌉 A vast, detailed recreation of San Francisco
🏍️ Motorcycles, scooters, BMX bikes & more
🌁 The iconic Golden Gate Bridge with live traffic
🛹 Skateparks, hidden spots & endless places to explore
🔧 Customize your rides and make them your own
💵 Ride, earn cash and expand your collection
👥 Cruise with friends or find your own way through the city

🎁 Join our Roblox group to claim a FREE motorcycle!
⭐ Like & favorite SF BIKE to support future updates.

ONE CITY. ENDLESS WAYS TO RIDE.
